publish_board.unlocks: every derivative format of that piece, on every channel but LinkedIn

derivative_formats.what: A card quoting the approved piece word for word
A card showing a sourced fact from the approved piece
A Substack Note quoting the approved piece
A Threads or X post quoting the approved piece
Story frames built only from the piece's approved assets
Shorts, Reels and TikTok cuts of the approved video
The plain re-share or restack of the published article

new_formats_need_eyes.what: A meme for Instagram, TikTok or YouTube; per-item approval
A post that says something the piece does not
A post reacting to news or another account

krish_hands.what: Posting on his personal LinkedIn; the engine only drafts
Buying or upgrading a plan, such as Buffer's
Creating, rotating or placing a key or password
Connecting an account to a tool, such as a channel in Buffer
